segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I’ve got the updated order in front of me: 42 seats, annual term starting March 1, and the services package for the data calibration work. Does that still match what you need for the rollout?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It does. The only thing I wanted to confirm is billing. Finance wants one invoice for the software and services together, not split across two POs.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. The quote shows one invoice for $38,760, net 30, tied to PO 4479. I’ll include that language in the order form so it’s clear.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the go-live date is still April 15? Our plant managers are planning around that week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. We have kickoff on March 6, data review by March 20, and user training on April 8 and 9. April 15 is the target go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On training, can we have two admin seats included for our quality team, or are those part of the 42?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They’re included in the 42. The breakdown is 34 standard users, 6 managers, and 2 admins. If that changes before launch, just send me the final names by March 29.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Legal had one comment on the auto-renewal clause. They’re okay with renewal, but they want 60 days’ notice instead of 90.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s fine. It’s within our standard terms, so I’ll send the order form with the 60-day notice language today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If you get that over by noon, I can route it for signature this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have it before noon, and once it’s signed, I’ll send the kickoff invite with the project lead copied.
